visualCharacteristics: New: fixed-height two-column banner, large image filling one half and intro text plus button in the other; the image side switches (flipped) by content order.
contentPattern: Fixed pair of different content side by side (text | portrait) that never wraps into a grid.
Fixed image | text pair side by side; color from section style.
usage: Tall two-column banner: a large image fills one half, heading, intro and button in the other. Image side follows authored cell order.
reuseGuidance: Use for prominent full-bleed split banners (principal message, apply CTA). For a smaller image beside text use columns-image-text.
tableStructure: Row 1: cell 1 text or image, cell 2 image or text
